newsitem.title: GERMANY: Middelhoff to be new Bertelsmann chief - paper.
newsitem.headline: Middelhoff to be new Bertelsmann chief - paper.

text.p: Germany's weekly Spiegel magazine said on Sunday that Thomas Middelhoff will take over as chairman of the German media giant Bertelsmann AG in October 1998.

Formerly a company board member in charge of corporate development and multimedia, Middelhoff will be presented by current chairman Mark Woessner at a management meeting on July 5 as his successor, the Speigel report said.

But asked for comment on the report, a spokesman for Bertelsmann said plans were that Woessner would propose a successor at the end of 1997 or early in 1998. He could not confirm whether the firm's board was considering Middelhoff.
